NEW PRIMARY DEFINITION. CMP119 p255(2.2) defines Gamma0=Omega1^c; Gamma_j=Omega_j^(j) minus Omega_(j+1)^(j), 1<=j<=k-1; Gamma_k=Omega_k^(k); and determining set B=union_j Gamma_j. The paragraph immediately below explicitly makes this definition separately for points, bonds and plaquettes, invoking the convention of Sect.0[I]. P256(2.10) sets the determining data V equal to V_j on Gamma_j. P256(2.11) defines M_B(U) by M^j(U) on Gamma_j, and(2.12) uses exactly those data to define the variational minimum. P256 expressly links V0 and the unchanged integration of the first step. Thus for k=1 there is no intermediate stratum: Gamma0 is fine scale and Gamma1=Omega1^(1) is coarse scale. They are labelled by different scales, not competing subsets of one fine set. M^0 is the zero-fold averaging identity on raw fine links; it is not the site gauge-averaging operator.

TYPED SPECIALIZATION PROPOSED. Write E0 for independent fine bonds and E1 for independent coarse bonds of the ORIGINAL source torus; X=Omega1 as the source union of compatible cubes. Let A=E_fine(X) be its incident fine bond set from CMP109 p251; let I=E_coarse(X) be its incident coarse bond set. Because(2.2) is explicitly meant separately for the bond sets, its fine Gamma0 is the complement E0 minus A AFTER selecting the fine bond stratum. Denote this actual source raw exterior F_src. Its coarse Gamma1 is I. The determining data at first step are therefore (U|F_src, M_I(U)), of different scales. This uses the physical source's OWN later definition to resolve the overloaded first-step notation; it does not borrow CMP96 or infer a convention solely from independent-Haar plausibility. It must be rejected if the separate-strata wording does not justify that operation order, or if the first-step link is inapplicable. Do not assert it just by giving a new definition to F.

PERIODIC AND PIVOT CONSEQUENCES. Retain all source-compatible geometry conditions of1801: odd L>11, genuine compatible Omega1 union, divisibility/alignment of actual partitions, periodic independent representatives, no intersections leaving faces only. The physical beta(c)=b0(c) in the coarse corridor has endpoints in B(c_-) and B(c_+). Every c in I has one coarse endpoint in X and its entire first block in X, so beta(c) has one fine endpoint in X. Thus beta(I) subset A and beta(I) disjoint F_src. The coordinate injection of the original beta on independent rows is already the conditional geometry accepted1801; source(2.2) is the proposed missing binding that lets it apply here. Inverse orientations remain dependent, not extra constraints. CMP119p247(1.8)-(1.9) excludes these same incident-row pivots from Xstar, and p249 counts and eliminates them. COARSE EXTERIOR AND THE COMPRESSED DELTA. The original physical transformation(0.1) has all independent coarse rows E1. Put J=E1 minus I. For the original compatible whole-cell geometry, these are precisely coarse segments wholly outside X, with crossing rows in I. No claim is made that Gamma0 can be averaged as a global coarse field, or that a coarse exterior is obtained by lifting the geometric complement incidently. Each physical mean row in J uses only its two exterior blocks and their translated straight paths; all fine links in that support belong to F_src. Hence define M_J^F(v) directly by those original local paths on the PARTIAL fine data v, without inventing values on A. This restricted map is extension-independent; M_J(u_A,v)=M_J^F(v).

OPERATIONAL EQUALITY TO TEST. For the original source integral, split the product of fine Haar variables as dU=dv_F du_A. The product coarse graph delta splits into the row factors for I and J. Keeping every original sector characteristic, gauge factor, action and observable inside a single original weight Phi_X(U,V), the source sector reads, weakly jointly in the whole coarse target V,
  int dv_F delta_J(M_J^F(v) V_J^-1)
      int du_A Phi_X((u,v),V) delta_I(M_I(u,v) V_I^-1).
This is an exact partition of coordinates and original constraints wherever the source integral is defined; it is not the 1985 enlarged-domain bound, not a pointwise regular-fiber assertion at every V, and introduces no determinant, renormalization or normalization factor. A weak test can be checked by integrating V_I,V_J against their normalized Haar measures; both sides evaluate the SAME test function and Phi on V=M(U). It requires integrability along that actual graph; ambient L1 alone is insufficient. For the original bounded finite-volume sector weights this is the ordinary graph measure interpretation, not a proof of uniform bounds. The source compressed delta on p249 is thereby given an operational restricted-row meaning. No fabricated Omega1^(c,(1)) subscript is attributed to the printed formula.

WHAT IS AND IS NOT PAID. The later variables in CMP119(1.15) are free Lie-algebra coordinates on Omega1star after nonlinear linearization and solving the coarse constraints; the conditional integral(1.26) then has an inner free-coordinate region and its complementary free coordinates. Those A_out are NOT simply F_src. The frozen LAW1559 and working manuscript have not yet been supplied with the complete same-coordinate/domain map to this original raw kernel.
